results.pattern_name: curvilinear arc (scratch) in right/lower-right quadrant on a background of random defects
results.process_step: CMP (post-CMP inspection of the metal/oxide polish module), including post-CMP brush scrubber

litho.pattern_name: center cluster (bullseye core) with radial streaks superimposed on random background
litho.process_step: Photoresist coat (dispense/spin) on LITHO-TRACK-03 coat module
litho.discriminating_check: Measure resist thickness/CD across the wafer (center vs mid-radius vs edge) on this lot and on the first wafer coated after the nozzle swap: a thick/thin center bullseye or dispense-splash signature at wafer center confirms coat nonuniformity, whereas flat thickness with normal CD would rule it out and point to random particle/defect sources.

cmp.pattern_name: center cluster with random scratch-like streaks (post-PM pad debris)
cmp.process_step: CMP (CMP-04) — first lots after unscheduled pad replacement PM
cmp.discriminating_check: Defect-inspection/optical review of the failing die for arc-shaped micro-scratches and embedded pad/slurry agglomerate particles, and check whether subsequent lots on CMP-04 after pad break-in/conditioning show the pattern disappear (vs. persisting, which would point to dishing or another tool)

litho.pattern_name: Upper-left localized cluster (comet/streak from center-left toward edge) superimposed on a partial edge ring
litho.process_step: Photoresist coat (spin coat) on LITHO-TRACK-03 coat module, post-PM nozzle replacement
litho.discriminating_check: Check post-coat resist thickness/defect scan (or wafer-to-wafer repeatability of the cluster's angular position relative to the notch): a radially oriented thickness excursion or striation/comet defect in the same upper-left sector on every wafer coated after the nozzle swap confirms coat nozzle dispense issue (bubble/partial clog/suckback); if the cluster location rotates randomly wafer-to-wafer or resist thickness maps are uniform, rule it out and look to particle contamination or bevel/edge effects instead

cmp.pattern_name: Upper-left localized cluster superimposed on a partial edge ring
cmp.process_step: Post-litho/metal CMP planarization on CMP-04 (first lot after unscheduled pad replacement PM)
cmp.discriminating_check: Inspect/review post-CMP defect (bright-field or SP1) maps for the same upper-left cluster of scratch/embedded-particle signatures aligned with the polish direction — presence of micro-scratches or pad-material particles in that region confirms pad break-in debris; a clean post-CMP inspection with failures only at electrical test would rule it out and point to an edge/film-thickness issue instead

litho.pattern_name: center cluster (bullseye core) with random background speckle
litho.process_step: Photoresist coat (dispense) on LITHO-TRACK-03 coat module — post-PM nozzle replacement
litho.discriminating_check: Inspect post-develop/post-coat wafers for a center resist thickness anomaly or air-bubble/dispense-splash signature at the wafer center (reflectometry thickness map of first-few wafers vs. later wafers, plus nozzle prime/suckback check); if center thickness/CD is on-target and uniform, spin-coat dispense is ruled out and a chuck/lift-pin or center hot-spot cause should be pursued.

cmp.pattern_name: center cluster (bullseye core) on elevated random background
cmp.process_step: CMP-04 post-PM pad break-in / oxide or metal polish
cmp.discriminating_check: Measure post-CMP thickness/remaining-film radial profile: a center-thick or center-over-polished dish (>3-sigma delta at r<25% radius) confirms CMP center non-uniformity from the new pad's un-broken-in center; a flat radial profile with randomly distributed particle-type defects would point to pad debris/particles instead.

litho.pattern_name: edge ring (outermost die ring failing continuously) with sparse random background defects
litho.process_step: Photoresist coat / edge bead removal on LITHO-TRACK-03 coat module (post-PM nozzle replacement)
litho.discriminating_check: Measure the EBR cut width / resist edge exclusion on a wafer from this lot (cross-wafer resist profile or optical inspection of the wafer edge): an EBR band encroaching further inboard than spec (or misaligned/asymmetric after the nozzle swap) confirms EBR; a properly placed, on-spec EBR line with the failing ring lying inside it would point instead to bevel etch or edge clamp/film rolloff.

cmp.pattern_name: continuous single-die-wide edge ring (full perimeter), plus low-level random background defects
cmp.process_step: CMP-04 post-PM polish (new pad break-in) at the metal/oxide planarization step
cmp.discriminating_check: Measure post-CMP radial thickness/removal-rate profile on this lot vs. a pre-PM lot: if the outer 3-5 mm shows excess removal (edge over-polish / residual step loss) that correlates with the failing ring, CMP is confirmed; if edge thickness is nominal and instead incoming film or EBR/bevel width is off, rule CMP out.

litho.pattern_name: Curvilinear comet/streak arc (spin-coat striation) from mid-radius toward lower-right edge, on a background of random defects
litho.process_step: Photoresist coat (spin coat module on LITHO-TRACK-03, post-PM nozzle replacement)
litho.discriminating_check: Overlay the failing die on a resist-thickness/reflectometry map of the same wafer: a comet-shaped thickness excursion trailing outward along the spin direction (and repeating with the same orientation on other wafers coated in that module after the nozzle swap) confirms spin-coat nonuniformity; if thickness is uniform and the arc instead follows a fixed reticle field or a CMP radial signature, rule it out

cmp.pattern_name: curvilinear scratch / arc-shaped defect streak through center toward lower-right edge, plus scattered random fails
cmp.process_step: CMP (CMP-04) — post-PM pad break-in / oxide or metal polish immediately following pad replacement
cmp.discriminating_check: Defect-inspection (bright-field/SEM) review along the streak: if the fails align with a continuous micro-scratch or embedded slurry-agglomerate/pad-fragment trail matching the polish sweep arc, CMP pad debris is confirmed; absence of physical scratches (electrical-only fails, no topography) would rule it out and point to a non-CMP cause.

litho.pattern_name: edge ring (outermost die ring failing)
litho.process_step: Photoresist coat / EBR at LITHO-TRACK-03 coat module (post-PM nozzle replacement)
litho.discriminating_check: Measure EBR cut width / resist edge profile on a monitor wafer from this track and compare to pre-PM baseline — an EBR band wider (or misaligned) than spec that matches the failing ring width confirms EBR misadjustment after the nozzle swap; a normal EBR width with instead a bevel-etch or clamp mark would rule it out

cmp.pattern_name: single-die-wide edge ring (outermost die failing all around wafer)
cmp.process_step: Deposition/edge-bead removal and edge exclusion at the film stack prior to CMP; check edge profile after depo/EBR
cmp.discriminating_check: Measure film thickness/CD radial profile in the outermost 3-5 mm (e.g., ellipsometry or cross-section at r=147-150 mm): a sharp thickness roll-off/EBR boundary coincident with the failing ring confirms edge roll-off, whereas a gradual 10-20 mm wide removal-rate gradient (broader band) would point to CMP edge over-polish from the new pad

litho.pattern_name: one-sided (right) edge band of failures on a background of random defects
litho.process_step: Resist coat / EBR at LITHO-TRACK-03 coat module (post-PM nozzle replacement)
litho.discriminating_check: Measure the EBR cut width / resist edge profile around the wafer circumference: an azimuthally asymmetric EBR band (wider or offset resist removal on the side matching the failing band, i.e. nozzle radial/centering offset after the PM) confirms EBR; a uniform, correctly centered EBR width with the band aligned to chuck/clamp or plasma-edge features instead points elsewhere

cmp.pattern_name: Localized edge cluster (right-side edge band) on random defect background
cmp.process_step: CMP (CMP-04) post-PM pad break-in / post-CMP clean
cmp.discriminating_check: Inspect the right-edge failing die with defect review/SEM after CMP: presence of pad-debris scratches or residual slurry agglomerates (and correlated post-CMP thickness/scratch signature on wafers from the first lots after the PM, disappearing in later lots) confirms pad debris; clean surfaces with an edge thickness roll-off instead would point to CMP edge dishing or a film edge effect.

litho.pattern_name: edge ring (outermost die failing continuously around perimeter)
litho.process_step: Photoresist coat / EBR at LITHO-TRACK-03 coat module (post-PM nozzle replacement)
litho.discriminating_check: Measure EBR cut width / resist edge profile on a monitor wafer from this track: an EBR width wider than spec (or misaligned EBR nozzle after the PM) that matches the failing ring radius confirms it; a normal EBR width with the ring persisting across other tools points instead to etch/bevel or film edge roll-off

cmp.pattern_name: single-die-wide continuous edge ring (outermost die row) with random background defectivity
cmp.process_step: Coat/develop track EBR at photoresist coat (verify EBR width setpoint) — plus confirm film edge roll-off from deposition/bevel etch
cmp.discriminating_check: Measure the radial extent of failure vs. EBR/bevel setpoint: if the fail band starts exactly at the EBR cut radius (sharp, one-die-wide, azimuthally uniform, with normal CD/thickness just inboard), EBR/edge film loss is confirmed; if instead the edge fails show a graded radial thickness/removal-rate gradient extending several die inward (or an azimuthal signature tied to carrier/retaining-ring position), the cause is CMP edge over-polish from the new pad, not EBR.

litho.pattern_name: localized edge-anchored cluster (left-side blob extending inward from wafer edge)

cmp.pattern_name: localized dense cluster at mid-left extending to wafer edge (single-sector blob) on random background

litho.pattern_name: Center swirl / spiral comet arc with random background speckle

cmp.pattern_name: curved arc / crescent scratch cluster (center-offset ring segment) with random background specks

cmp.discriminating_check: Post-CMP brightfield defect inspection or optical review of the failing arc: if it shows arcuate mechanical scratches/gouges concentric with the platen sweep (and defect map matches the electrical arc), pad debris/inadequate break-in is confirmed; smooth thickness-only variation with no scratches would rule it out and point to dishing/erosion instead.

litho.pattern_name: Radial coat streak (comet) from wafer center toward top edge, superimposed on random background defectivity

cmp.pattern_name: random-clustered defect signature (multi-die clusters superimposed on scattered singles), no radial/edge dependence
cmp.process_step: CMP-04 post-PM polish (new pad break-in) followed by post-CMP clean/inspection

litho.pattern_name: full-perimeter edge ring failure (1-2 die wide) with superimposed random defectivity
litho.process_step: Photoresist coat / EBR on LITHO-TRACK-03 coat module (nozzle replaced at PM 18 h prior)
litho.discriminating_check: Measure the EBR cut width / resist edge profile on a monitor wafer from that coat module and compare to pre-PM baseline: if the EBR width has shifted inward (or the dispense nozzle is off-center, giving asymmetric resist edge roll-off) the edge ring is confirmed; if EBR width is on target and the same ring appears on wafers coated on other tracks, rule it out and look to bevel etch or edge clamp contact.

cmp.pattern_name: Full-perimeter edge ring (1-2 die wide) with a short linear/arc defect cluster near upper-left; remaining failures are random background
cmp.process_step: Post-pad-replacement CMP polish on CMP-04 (metal/oxide planarization) - check edge removal rate profile and break-in state of the new pad

litho.pattern_name: center cluster with partial edge ring (bullseye-plus-center-blob)

litho.discriminating_check: Inspect post-coat resist thickness/defect scan at wafer center: an air bubble or dried-tip particle from the newly replaced dispense nozzle should show a localized center thickness anomaly or comet/striation defect signature; if center resist thickness and post-develop CD are on-target and uniform, spin-coat/nozzle cause is ruled out (then look at etch chamber or random particle sources).

cmp.pattern_name: center cluster with edge ring (random background)
cmp.process_step: CMP (CMP-04) post-PM pad break-in / post-CMP clean
cmp.discriminating_check: Defect review of the center cluster dies: if SEM/optical shows embedded pad debris or micro-scratches in the polished layer (and the cluster disappears on lots run after pad break-in/conditioning), CMP pad debris is confirmed; purely electrical opens with no surface defects would rule it out

litho.pattern_name: edge ring (full-perimeter, ~1-2 die wide) with sparse random background failures
litho.process_step: Photoresist coat / EBR on LITHO-TRACK-03 coat module (nozzle replaced at recent PM)
litho.discriminating_check: Measure the EBR cut width / resist edge profile on a monitor wafer from this track (or compare pre/post-PM EBR recipe offsets and nozzle alignment): an EBR band extending inward beyond spec (over-dispense/misaligned nozzle after replacement) confirms it, whereas a nominal ~1-2 mm EBR width with normal resist coverage at the outermost die rules it out and points to a bevel-etch or edge-clamp mechanism instead

cmp.pattern_name: single-die-wide edge ring (full-perimeter) with light random background scatter
cmp.process_step: CMP-04 post-PM polish step (pad break-in / retaining-ring edge over-polish) following the unscheduled pad replacement
cmp.discriminating_check: Measure post-CMP film thickness / remaining-step-height radial profile out to r>145 mm on this lot vs. a pre-PM lot: strong edge over-removal (thin film) in the outer 3-5 mm confirms CMP edge over-polish from an un-broken-in pad; a flat radial removal profile with the edge ring instead tracking the coater EBR/bevel-etch boundary would rule it out and point to film edge roll-off

litho.pattern_name: edge ring (single-to-double die wide continuous ring of failures at wafer perimeter) with superimposed random defectivity
litho.process_step: Photoresist coat / EBR at LITHO-TRACK-03 coat module (post-PM nozzle replacement)
litho.discriminating_check: Measure the EBR cut width / resist edge profile on a monitor wafer from this track and compare to pre-PM baseline: if the EBR band has widened (or the dispense/EBR nozzle is off-center, giving an asymmetric resist edge) so that resist is removed inside the outermost die row, EBR is confirmed; a uniform, on-spec EBR width with the same edge ring appearing at other layers/tools would rule it out and point to bevel etch or edge clamp contact

cmp.process_step: CMP (CMP-04) post-pad-replacement polish — check edge removal rate profile / break-in

cmp.pattern_name: edge ring (outermost 1-2 die rows) failing continuously around wafer, plus low-level random background defectivity

litho.pattern_name: center blob with radial 'comet' streak toward wafer edge, plus elevated random/edge fails

litho.discriminating_check: Inspect post-coat resist thickness/defect map (or macro-inspect a few wafers of the lot): a comet/streak of thickness deviation originating near wafer center and trailing radially outward, repeating on wafers coated on the same module/nozzle, confirms coat nozzle dispense (bubble/partial-clog/mis-set dispense height) as cause; absence of a radial thickness streak with random defect distribution instead points to particle contamination.

cmp.pattern_name: random-clustered scratch/smear defects with curvilinear streaks (post-PM pad break-in debris)

cmp.discriminating_check: Review defect-inspection maps and SEM of failing die for arc-shaped micro-scratches/slurry agglomerate residue aligned with polish rotation; if wafers from the same tool after full pad break-in and dummy conditioning are clean, pad debris is confirmed — absence of scratches/embedded particles would rule it out

litho.pattern_name: edge ring (single-die-wide continuous ring of failures at wafer perimeter, plus low-level random background defects)
litho.process_step: Photoresist coat / EBR on LITHO-TRACK-03 coat module (nozzle replaced at PM 18 h prior)

litho.pattern_name: center cluster with radial streak arms (bullseye/spoke center defect)

cmp.pattern_name: center cluster with radial scratch-like streaks

litho.pattern_name: Radial coat streak (comet) from wafer center to left edge, plus random defectivity

results.pattern_name: full-circumference edge ring (outer 1-2 die rows), slightly wider on the right edge, plus low-level random background scatter

results.process_step: CMP (CMP-04) post-PM pad break-in / polish uniformity

results.process_step: CMP-04 post-PM new-pad polish (metal/oxide CMP) — pad break-in / edge removal-rate uniformity

results.pattern_name: edge ring (outermost 1-2 die rows failing continuously around circumference) with superimposed random defect speckle

results.process_step: CMP (CMP-04) post-PM pad break-in / post-CMP clean
results.discriminating_check: Inspect post-CMP defect review images for scratches/pad-debris particles and check whether the first wafers after the pad change show the highest defect counts (break-in trend); if edge ring persists on lots from other polishers with no particle signature, cause is edge film/EBR instead

results.pattern_name: edge ring (outermost 1-2 die rows failing continuously around the perimeter, with only sparse random defects in the interior)
results.process_step: CMP-04 post-PM new-pad polish step (metal/oxide CMP immediately preceding this test)
results.discriminating_check: Pull the post-CMP film thickness/removal radial profile for this lot and compare wafers polished before vs. after the pad change: if the outer 3-5 mm shows excess removal (edge over-polish / residual clearing failure) that appears only on post-PM wafers, CMP pad break-in is confirmed; if the edge thickness profile is identical to pre-PM lots, the ring is a pre-existing edge exclusion/EBR or film roll-off artifact and CMP is ruled out.

results.pattern_name: edge ring failure band (with scattered center defects)
results.process_step: CMP (CMP-04) post-pad-replacement polish; check edge removal rate profile and post-CMP film thickness map
results.discriminating_check: Measure post-CMP remaining film/step-height radial profile: if the outer 3-5 mm shows over-polish (thinning/dishing) versus center, CMP edge over-removal from the new pad is confirmed; if edge thickness matches center, look instead at coat/bake or bevel-etch edge effects

results.pattern_name: edge ring (outer 1-2 die rows) with superimposed random scatter
results.process_step: CMP (CMP-04) immediately following unscheduled PM / pad replacement - pad break-in and conditioning
results.discriminating_check: Run post-CMP defect inspection plus radial removal-rate profile on this lot vs. the next lots on CMP-04: a fresh-pad signature shows slurry/pad debris particles and micro-scratches concentrated in the outer 10 mm along with elevated edge removal rate, and both should decay away once the pad is fully broken in. If edge failures persist at the same radius on well-conditioned pads (and the same ring appears on other tools), CMP pad debris is ruled out and an edge-bead/film-edge rolloff cause should be pursued.

a.pattern_name: localized dense cluster in lower-left/bottom quadrant on a background of random defects
a.process_step: post-CMP / deposition inspection at the layer where the cluster first appears; check wafer-level defect inspection maps (KLA) for this lot
a.discriminating_check: Overlay inline defect inspection maps layer-by-layer: if a matching high-density particle/scratch cluster appears in the same lower-left region at one specific step (and is absent at the prior step), particle/debris contamination is confirmed; if the electrical fails have no corresponding physical defect signature, suspect probe-card contact or a chuck/thermal effect instead

b.pattern_name: localized bottom/lower-left cluster (sector-shaped edge cluster)
b.process_step: unknown - inspect wafer-level defect inspection after deposition/CMP/etch modules
b.discriminating_check: Overlay inline defect inspection maps at each layer: a matching dense particle/scratch cluster in the lower-left quadrant at one specific step confirms particle/debris contamination; if instead CD/thickness metrology shows a smooth radial or thermal gradient with no defect adders, rule it out.

a.pattern_name: edge ring (perimeter-concentrated failures)
a.process_step: photoresist coat / edge bead removal and edge exposure prior to litho
a.discriminating_check: Radial binning of yield: confirm failure rate rises sharply only in the outermost 2-3 die rows (>5 mm edge band) while center is at baseline, and check EBR cut width / resist edge profile on a coated monitor wafer — a wide or ragged EBR boundary confirms; uniform resist thickness to the edge rules it out (then look at bevel etch or plasma edge nonuniformity)

b.pattern_name: edge ring / peripheral fail band
b.process_step: photoresist coat / EBR and edge exposure prior to etch
b.discriminating_check: Radial binning of yield: confirm fail rate rises sharply only in the outermost 1-2 die rings (>~90% radius) with a uniform interior; then inspect resist edge profile/EBR width and CD-SEM at wafer edge — a wide or ragged EBR boundary coincident with the fail ring confirms, while a uniform resist edge with edge-only film thickness or bevel etch encroachment points elsewhere

a.pattern_name: center blob cluster with elevated edge ring
a.process_step: CMP (oxide/metal polish) — center removal-rate uniformity
a.discriminating_check: Post-CMP thickness/removal-rate radial profile: a pronounced center over-polish (dishing/residue) matching the blob diameter confirms CMP; a flat radial profile with random defect-map particle signature would rule it out in favor of particle/slurry contamination

b.pattern_name: center blob cluster with scattered random defects
b.process_step: CMP (post-metal/oxide planarization) — center removal-rate profile
b.discriminating_check: Measure post-CMP thickness/step-height radial profile: a pronounced center dish (over-polish) or residue at wafer center that correlates with the failing blob confirms CMP; uniform thickness with center particle signature would instead point to a slurry/particle or chuck-contact cause

a.pattern_name: center cluster (bullseye core) with scattered random background
a.process_step: CMP (oxide/metal planarization) — verify center-fast removal signature
a.discriminating_check: Measure post-CMP thickness/CD radial profile: a distinct center-low (over-polish) region matching the failing core confirms CMP dishing; a flat radial profile with the cluster tracking a particle/defect map instead points to random particle contamination

b.pattern_name: center cluster with random scatter
b.process_step: CMP (oxide/metal planarization)
b.discriminating_check: Measure post-CMP thickness/removal-rate radial profile: a center-heavy over-polish (dishing/thinning at wafer center) confirms CMP; a flat radial profile with randomly distributed defects points instead to particle contamination

a.pattern_name: Bottom-edge asymmetric crescent cluster (one-sided half-wafer signature) superimposed on random defectivity
a.process_step: Photoresist coat / develop track (spin-coat and post-develop rinse on the coater track), plus film thickness at the lower wafer edge
a.discriminating_check: Map resist/film thickness and CD across the wafer with an orientation-referenced (notch-aligned) scan: a monotonic thickness/CD roll-off or striation concentrated in the bottom crescent that stays fixed to the wafer notch (and repeats on other wafers from the same coat module) confirms coat/develop nonuniformity; if the heavy-fail crescent instead rotates with wafer orientation between tools, or correlates with edge-ring/clamp contact marks or a directional etch/plasma skew, rule it out.

b.pattern_name: Asymmetric bottom (lower-half/one-sided) cluster with superimposed random defectivity
b.process_step: Photoresist post-apply/post-exposure bake hotplate (and associated litho track coat/develop for the affected wafer orientation)
b.discriminating_check: Overlay the fail region against wafer notch/orientation for other wafers in the lot and map hotplate zone thermocouple/CD data: a fixed, orientation-locked lower-half CD shift (>2-3 nm systematic offset) tracking a cold/hot bake-plate zone confirms thermal non-uniformity; if instead the region shows film thickness or residue signature (or moves with wafer rotation), the cause is coat/develop or wet-clean related.

a.pattern_name: edge ring (outermost die ring fully failing)
a.process_step: photoresist coat / edge bead removal (and bevel etch) at the critical litho-etch module
a.discriminating_check: Measure resist/film thickness and CD radially in the outer 3-5 mm: an abrupt EBR cut-line coincident with the failing ring confirms EBR/edge film rolloff; if instead the edge die fail electrically with normal film profile and parametric signature matching plasma or clamp effects, EBR is ruled out

b.pattern_name: edge ring (outermost die ring fail)
b.process_step: Photoresist coat / edge bead removal and bevel etch at the lithography track
b.discriminating_check: Measure film thickness/CD radially in the outer 3-5 mm: an abrupt resist thickness roll-off or EBR cut line coinciding exactly with the failing die ring confirms EBR width misadjustment; if film is uniform to the edge and failures instead track probe contact or bevel etch encroachment, rule it out.

a.pattern_name: gross/global fail (near-total wafer failure with only sparse passing die near bottom edge)
a.process_step: Full-wafer electrical fail — review lot travel history for a skipped/incorrect layer (e.g., implant, litho exposure, or metal deposition/etch) and any tool abort events
a.discriminating_check: Compare in-line metrology (film thickness, CD, Rs) and PCM parametric data for this wafer against the lot mean: a uniform, wafer-wide parametric shift (e.g., missing implant dose or open metal continuity on all sites) confirms misprocess, whereas normal in-line metrology with only functional fails would point to a probe/test artifact or contact issue instead.

b.pattern_name: global gross fail (near-total wafer failure, only a few scattered passing die at bottom)
b.process_step: unknown - review full lot travel history for a recipe/layer mismatch or aborted step; verify probe card/test program setup first
b.discriminating_check: Re-test the wafer with a verified probe card and correct test program: if yield stays ~0% with no parametric signal (e.g., all opens/shorts on E-test structures across the wafer), it is a real misprocess rather than a test artifact; then compare in-line film thickness/CD measurements against spec for each layer to find the step that deviates.

a.pattern_name: edge ring failure (full-perimeter outermost die fail) with low-level random background
a.process_step: Photoresist coat / edge bead removal (and film edge roll-off at deposition)
a.discriminating_check: Measure film thickness/CD radially in the outer 3-5 mm: an abrupt roll-off or resist thinning coincident with the EBR cut line confirms EBR/edge film loss; uniform edge film thickness with the failures instead tracking bevel etch or clamp marks rules it out

b.pattern_name: edge ring (full-perimeter outermost die failure) with low-level random background
b.process_step: Photoresist coat / edge bead removal and bevel etch at the lithography and etch modules
b.discriminating_check: Measure film thickness/CD radially on the outer 5 mm: an abrupt resist thickness or CD rolloff coincident with the EBR cut line (and failures confined to the outermost one die ring only) confirms EBR/edge film rolloff; a smoothly increasing radial degradation extending several die inward would instead point to plasma or thermal nonuniformity.

a.pattern_name: curvilinear (arc) scratch in upper-right quadrant with random background defects and a bottom-edge cluster
a.process_step: CMP (post-CMP inspection of the layer preceding this test level)
a.discriminating_check: Bright/dark-field defect inspection or SEM along the arc: a continuous micro-scratch/gouge track with embedded slurry-agglomerate debris confirms CMP pad/slurry scratching; if instead the arc dies show only isolated particles or no topographic groove, rule it out and look at handling or chamber flaking

b.pattern_name: curvilinear scratch (arc) in upper-right quadrant superimposed on random background defectivity, with mild edge-die clustering at top and bottom
b.process_step: CMP (oxide/metal planarization) and post-CMP clean/inspection prior to this test layer
b.discriminating_check: Run bright-field/darkfield defect inspection or optical review on the failing upper-right die: a continuous arc-shaped micro-scratch with embedded slurry/pad debris confirms CMP scratching, whereas isolated random particles with no linear connectivity would rule it out and point to general particle contamination

a.pattern_name: edge ring (full-perimeter edge failure band) with a faint diagonal scratch-like streak
a.process_step: photoresist coat / edge bead removal and post-develop edge inspection (also check bevel etch at same layer)
a.discriminating_check: Measure film thickness/CD radially from center to within 3 mm of the edge: an abrupt EBR cut line coinciding with the inner boundary of the failing ring (and matching the ring radius on all wafers of the lot) confirms EBR overspray/width error; a gradual radial roll-off instead points to coat/film edge rolloff or bevel etch encroachment.

b.pattern_name: Edge ring with discrete azimuthal clusters (12/6 o'clock dominant, smaller 3/9 o'clock) superimposed on random background defects
b.process_step: Clamped wafer processing step (e.g., plasma etch / PVD with mechanical clamp ring or edge-gripping handling), inspect at post-etch/post-deposition edge inspection
b.discriminating_check: Overlay the failing die azimuth positions against the clamp finger/pad locations on the chuck: if the 4 failure clusters (~12, 3, 6, 9 o'clock) land exactly on clamp contact pads and defect review shows mechanical scratches/backside marks plus local film thickness or CD shift there, edge_clamp_contact is confirmed; a uniform, azimuthally continuous edge band with no discrete clusters would instead point to edge bead removal / film edge roll-off.

a.pattern_name: center cluster with scattered random defects
a.process_step: unknown
a.discriminating_check: Inline defect inspection (post-etch/post-CMP) for a center-weighted particle adder signature; if defect maps show a central particle cluster matching the failing die, particle contamination is confirmed — if center die fail with no defect adders but show CD/thickness deviation, suspect chuck/deposition center nonuniformity instead

b.pattern_name: none
b.process_step: unknown
b.discriminating_check: Compare failure density in radial zones (center/mid/edge) across the lot; a flat radial profile with random nearest-neighbor spacing confirms random defectivity rather than a systematic signature. Also check inline particle/defect inspection maps for a matching cluster.

a.pattern_name: edge ring fail band (outermost die ring)
a.process_step: photoresist coat / EBR and edge exposure prior to etch; verify with film thickness and CD at wafer edge
a.discriminating_check: Radial profile of film thickness/CD in the outer 5 mm: an abrupt resist thickness rolloff coincident with the EBR cut line confirms EBR/edge coating; if instead the edge fails are electrically identical to bevel-etch metal loss or show uniform good film, look to bevel etch or probe contact at edge

b.pattern_name: edge ring (outermost die failing continuously around perimeter)
b.process_step: photoresist coat / EBR and edge exposure prior to etch
b.discriminating_check: Measure resist/film thickness and CD radially in the outer 5 mm: an abrupt resist thickness rolloff or EBR cut line coinciding with the failing ring confirms EBR width misset; if instead the film thickness is normal and only bevel-etch encroachment or clamp marks are seen, rule it out

a.pattern_name: none
a.process_step: unknown
a.discriminating_check: Compare defect coordinates across multiple wafers in the lot: repeatable clustering at fixed radii/reticle positions would indicate a systematic mechanism, while non-repeatable scattered singletons plus small random clusters confirms baseline random particle/defect yield loss.

b.pattern_name: none
b.process_step: unknown
b.discriminating_check: Overlay defect inspection maps (post-etch/post-CMP) with the bin map across multiple wafers in the lot: if failure sites remain randomly scattered with no radial, edge, or clustered dependence and vary wafer-to-wafer, it is baseline random defectivity rather than a systematic tool signature.

a.pattern_name: edge ring (perimeter die failure) with random background defects
a.process_step: photoresist coat / edge bead removal and subsequent edge exposure-etch at wafer perimeter
a.discriminating_check: Measure radial failure rate vs. radius and inspect film/CD at the outermost 3-5 mm: a sharp step in resist thickness or CD exactly at the EBR cut line (constant width all around the wafer) confirms EBR/edge film rolloff; if the ring is azimuthally non-uniform or correlates with clamp/pin locations, rule it out.

b.pattern_name: edge ring (full-perimeter edge die failure) with superimposed random defects
b.process_step: photoresist coat / edge bead removal (and subsequent pattern transfer at wafer edge)
b.discriminating_check: Measure radial failure onset: if failures form a sharp, uniform-width annulus starting at a fixed radius (~3-5 mm from edge) with normal CD/film thickness just inside it, EBR/film edge roll-off is confirmed; if instead film thickness/CD degrades gradually inward or the ring width varies azimuthally, suspect coat/plasma edge nonuniformity or bevel etch encroachment.

a.pattern_name: partial edge ring (localized arc along right/lower-right wafer edge) superimposed on random background defectivity
a.process_step: Photoresist spin coat / edge bead removal (track coat module) prior to litho
a.discriminating_check: Azimuthal profile of resist/film thickness and EBR cut width at the wafer edge (e.g., 1-3 mm from edge, measured every 45 degrees): an EBR cut that is wider or ragged only over the failing 90-120 degree arc confirms EBR/coat nozzle misalignment, whereas a uniform EBR width with symmetric edge film would rule it out and point instead to a clamp/bevel-etch asymmetry

b.pattern_name: partial edge ring (localized arc on right/bottom-right edge) with random background defects
b.process_step: photoresist coat / edge bead removal and edge exposure prior to etch
b.discriminating_check: Inspect wafer edge in the failing azimuthal sector for resist/film roll-off or EBR width asymmetry (e.g., cross-section or CD/film-thickness radial scan at 0-10 mm from edge); a uniform EBR width and normal film thickness in that sector would rule out EBR and point to a clamp/bevel-etch asymmetry instead.

a.pattern_name: one-sided (right-half) failure concentration with random background
a.process_step: photoresist coat / develop or single-wafer wet process (asymmetric radial-azimuthal uniformity)
a.discriminating_check: Overlay CD/film-thickness maps for the lot rotated to wafer notch orientation: if the high-fail half consistently aligns with the same wafer coordinate (and thickness/CD drifts monotonically across that half) the coat/dispense asymmetry is confirmed; if the failing half rotates lot-to-lot or aligns with chamber azimuth instead, suspect plasma/chuck azimuthal nonuniformity

b.pattern_name: one-sided (right-half) failure gradient
b.process_step: plasma etch / deposition chamber (asymmetric RF or gas flow)
b.discriminating_check: Check whether the high-fail region rotates with wafer orientation notch across lot wafers: if failures stay fixed to the same chamber azimuth (not wafer notch), it confirms a chamber asymmetry such as skewed plasma density/gas flow; also compare in-line CD/thickness maps for a matching left-to-right gradient

a.pattern_name: none
a.process_step: unknown
a.discriminating_check: Compare wafer-to-wafer/lot-level radial and zonal fail-rate binning: if the fail fraction is statistically flat from center to edge (no radial or azimuthal trend) and fails are spatially uncorrelated (nearest-neighbor clustering index ~1), the loss is random baseline defectivity rather than a tool-specific signature; a rising edge-zone or repeating reticle-field trend would instead point to a systematic cause.

b.pattern_name: none
b.process_step: unknown
b.discriminating_check: Compute radial and zonal fail-rate profiles (center vs mid vs edge annulus) and run a clustering/spatial-randomness test (e.g., Moran's I or nearest-neighbor); if fail density is statistically uniform across zones with no clustering, the loss is random/parametric rather than a spatial signature, pointing to a global defect-density or test-limit issue instead of a tool-specific mechanism.

a.pattern_name: center cluster with random background defectivity
a.process_step: Deposition/etch chamber or CMP post-clean — inspect defect maps at center of wafer
a.discriminating_check: Run wafer-level defect inspection (KLA) after each suspect step: a coincident cluster of particles at wafer center at one specific step confirms particle contamination; absence of physical defects at the center (i.e., purely electrical/parametric failure with radial CD or thickness signature) would rule it out and point to chuck/showerhead center-fed nonuniformity

b.pattern_name: center cluster (localized blob) on high random background
b.process_step: post-deposition/CMP defect inspection of the layer preceding this test; check in-line particle maps at the wafer center
b.discriminating_check: Overlay in-line darkfield inspection maps for this lot: if a tight cluster of adder particles/scratches is found at the same center coordinates at one specific layer, particle contamination is confirmed; if instead the center fails correlate with a radial thickness/CD roll-off (uniform, symmetric radial gradient in metrology) with no adders, it is CMP/deposition uniformity, not particles

a.pattern_name: localized_cluster_left_midradius_with_random_background
a.process_step: unknown - inspect defect inspection data at deposition/etch steps preceding test
a.discriminating_check: Overlay inline defect inspection (e.g., post-etch/post-dep KLA) maps for this wafer: a matching localized particle/scratch cluster at the same left mid-radius coordinates confirms particle contamination; absence of any inline defect signature there would point instead to an electrical/probe artifact or random yield loss

b.pattern_name: localized cluster on left/lower-left region with random background defectivity
b.process_step: unknown — inspect defect inspection data at post-CMP / post-deposition steps for the layer preceding electrical fail
b.discriminating_check: Overlay inline defect inspection maps (KLA) for the lot: if a matching cluster of particles appears at a specific layer in the same left/lower-left coordinates, particle contamination is confirmed; if inspection is clean there and the fails instead track a CD/thickness gradient, it is a process nonuniformity instead.

a.pattern_name: edge ring (perimeter failure band)
a.process_step: photoresist coat / edge bead removal and edge exposure prior to litho
a.discriminating_check: Measure radial position of the failing ring against the EBR cut line: if failures start abruptly at a fixed radius matching the EBR/edge-exposure width (uniform all around, ~1 die wide) it confirms coat/EBR; if the band width varies azimuthally or correlates with film thickness rolloff or bevel etch encroachment, it points to deposition/bevel etch instead.

b.pattern_name: edge ring failure (outermost die ring)
b.process_step: photoresist coat / edge bead removal and post-develop edge inspection
b.discriminating_check: Measure radial CD/film thickness profile: if resist thickness rolls off or EBR cut line encroaches inboard of the last die ring (and failures start exactly at that radius), EBR/coat edge rolloff is confirmed; if instead edge die show etch-depth or bevel damage without resist anomaly, suspect bevel etch instead

a.pattern_name: edge ring failure (outermost die ring) with random background defects
a.process_step: photoresist coat / edge bead removal and bevel clean prior to etch
a.discriminating_check: Measure resist/film thickness and CD radially in the outer 3-5 mm: an abrupt EBR cut-in or resist roll-off at the exact radius where the failing ring begins confirms EBR; if instead the ring die fail electrically with normal film profile, suspect probe edge contact or bevel etch encroachment

b.pattern_name: edge ring (outermost die ring failing) with random background defectivity
b.process_step: photoresist coat / edge bead removal (and subsequent edge film integrity at litho-etch module)
b.discriminating_check: Measure film thickness/CD radially at the wafer edge (e.g., 145-150 mm radius): an abrupt resist/film thickness drop or EBR cut line coinciding exactly with the failing outer die ring confirms EBR width misset; if edge film thickness is normal and failures instead correlate with a bevel-etch or clamp footprint, rule it out.

a.pattern_name: center cluster (bullseye core) on random background
a.process_step: Cu/oxide CMP planarization (post-CMP thickness and defect inspection)
a.discriminating_check: Measure post-CMP remaining film thickness / step height along a wafer diameter: a pronounced center thinning (dishing/over-polish) coincident with the failing die radius confirms CMP; a flat radial profile with clustered particle defects at wafer center in post-CMP inspection would point instead to particle/scrubber contamination

b.pattern_name: center cluster (bullseye core) on random background
b.process_step: Cu/oxide CMP planarization (post-CMP electrical test)
b.discriminating_check: Measure post-CMP remaining film thickness / step height along a center-to-edge radial trace: a center-fast (thinner oxide or over-polished/dished Cu) profile coincident with the failing die radius confirms CMP; a flat radial thickness profile with the same center failures points instead to a chamber/plasma center effect or particle cluster

a.pattern_name: edge ring (full-perimeter edge exclusion failure) with random background defectivity
a.process_step: Photoresist coat / edge bead removal and subsequent edge exclusion at litho-etch module
a.discriminating_check: Measure radial fail rate: confirm failures are confined to the outermost 1-2 die rings (>~95% of edge die failing uniformly in azimuth); then inspect EBR cut width / resist edge profile on a coated monitor wafer — an EBR width larger than spec (resist pulled back into active die) confirms it, while a symmetric CD/film-thickness rolloff without resist pullback would point to film edge rolloff instead

b.pattern_name: edge ring (full-perimeter edge fail band) with random background defectivity
b.process_step: Photoresist coat / edge bead removal and edge exposure prior to etch; check EBR width and film edge roll-off
b.discriminating_check: Measure film thickness/CD radially: if the fail band starts exactly where EBR cut-line/film thickness rolls off (~last 2-3 mm), EBR width is the cause; if edge fails instead correlate with clamp/pin marks or a bevel-etch encroachment profile, rule it out

a.pattern_name: center cluster (bullseye core) with random background defects
a.process_step: Cu/oxide CMP planarization (post-CMP thickness/defect inspection)
a.discriminating_check: Measure post-CMP remaining film thickness/step height radially: a pronounced center thinning (over-polish) or residual-metal ring coincident with the failing central die confirms CMP dishing; flat radial profile with a matching center particle/scratch signature on post-CMP defect inspection would rule it out

b.pattern_name: center cluster (bullseye core) with random background scatter
b.process_step: CMP (oxide/metal planarization) - center removal-rate control; verify with post-CMP thickness map and defect inspection
b.discriminating_check: Take a post-CMP film thickness / remaining-step-height radial map: a distinct center thinning (over-polish) or residue peak co-located with the failing center die confirms CMP center non-uniformity; if thickness is flat across radius and the center failures instead correlate with a dense particle/scratch signature on post-CMP inspection, CMP dishing is ruled out in favor of particle contamination.

a.pattern_name: center cluster (dense irregular blob near wafer center with scattered satellite fails)
a.process_step: deposition/etch chamber where wafer is chucked face-up (check post-deposition and post-etch inline defect inspection for center-region defect cluster)
a.discriminating_check: Run inline defect inspection (KLA brightfield) overlay on this lot: if a matching center-region cluster of localized adder particles/residue appears at one specific step, particle contamination is confirmed; if instead the center region shows a smooth radial CD/thickness gradient with no localized adders, the cause is a radial process nonuniformity (e.g., CMP dishing or plasma density) not particles.

b.pattern_name: center-biased irregular fail cluster with random background scatter
b.process_step: post-CMP clean / deposition chamber (inspect defect maps at the immediately preceding depo-and-clean module)
b.discriminating_check: Overlay inline defect-inspection (post-CMP / post-depo KLA) maps for this lot: a coincident cluster of large (>0.5 um) particles or a smear/scratch signature in the same center-right region confirms particulate contamination; if inspection is clean and instead center CD/thickness metrology is out of spec radially, the cause is CMP dishing or plasma-density nonuniformity instead.

a.pattern_name: asymmetric (single-azimuth) edge arc at top of wafer, superimposed on random background defectivity
a.process_step: Etch/deposition step using a mechanical clamp or edge-gripping end effector (check clamp ring seating and wafer notch orientation)
a.discriminating_check: Overlay failing edge die against wafer notch/orientation reference across the lot: if the failing arc always lands at the same azimuth relative to the clamp/pin locations (and inspection shows scratches, discoloration, or film residue only there), edge clamp contact is confirmed; if the arc azimuth rotates wafer-to-wafer or shows a uniform full-ring width, it is instead an EBR/bevel-etch or spin-coat uniformity issue

b.pattern_name: localized top-edge (single azimuthal sector) edge ring failure with random background defects
b.process_step: wafer edge handling/clamping at deposition or etch chuck; check edge exclusion at coat/develop
b.discriminating_check: Check whether the dense fail cluster consistently occurs at the same wafer azimuth (relative to notch) across multiple wafers in the lot — a fixed notch-referenced sector points to clamp/contact or shadowing, while random rotation of the sector points to handling or centering error; also inspect edge die for physical contact marks or film thickness rolloff via profilometry.

a.pattern_name: none (global/gross yield loss, spatially random)
a.process_step: unknown
a.discriminating_check: Check parametric/e-test data and lot-level yield trend: if the whole lot shows uniformly depressed yield with a common failing bin (e.g., all-fail continuity or Vt shift), suspect a global misprocess or test setup issue rather than a spatial defect mechanism; a radial or edge yield gradient in the fail-rate contour would instead point to a chamber/uniformity cause.

b.pattern_name: global gross yield loss (whole-wafer fail, no localized spatial signature)
b.process_step: Verify lot travel history at all critical layers (litho exposure/develop, implant, key etch/dep) for recipe or tool mismatch; also confirm probe card/test program setup
b.discriminating_check: Re-probe the wafer with a verified test program on a different prober/probe card: if yield recovers, it was a test artifact; if the wafer still fails globally, pull inline CD/film/electrical PCM data (e.g., Vt, sheet Rs, contact resistance) and compare with the golden recipe values to identify the missed or wrong process step.

a.pattern_name: localized cluster (blob) near wafer center with random background defects
a.process_step: Deposition/etch chamber or CMP slurry — inspect defect review at layers preceding probe; check post-CMP/post-dep inspection for a matching macro particle or scratch cluster
a.discriminating_check: Overlay inline defect inspection maps layer-by-layer: a coincident large-particle/residue signature at the same x-y location confirms particle contamination; absence of any inline defect there (and identical blob location on other wafers in lot) would point instead to a reticle field defect or probe artifact

b.pattern_name: localized cluster (blob) near wafer center with random background defects
b.process_step: unknown — inspect defect review at post-deposition/post-CMP inspection layers
b.discriminating_check: Overlay inline defect inspection maps by layer: if a cluster of large particles/scratch residue appears at the same x,y coordinates at a specific layer (and not on other wafers at the same slot position), it confirms particle contamination rather than a chamber- or chuck-related radial signature

a.pattern_name: edge ring (full-perimeter edge failure band)
a.process_step: photoresist coat / EBR at litho track, plus edge film integrity checks
a.discriminating_check: Measure radial CD/film thickness profile and inspect EBR cut width: if resist edge-bead removal extends inward beyond the intended ~2-3 mm (or resist rolls off) exactly matching the failing ring radius, EBR is confirmed; if edge CD/thickness is nominal and instead the ring correlates with bevel etch or clamp footprint, rule it out.

b.pattern_name: edge ring (perimeter failure band) with random background defectivity
b.process_step: photoresist coat / edge bead removal and subsequent etch at wafer edge
b.discriminating_check: Measure radial CD/film thickness profile: if resist thickness rolls off and EBR cut line lands ~2-3 mm inside the outermost die row matching the failing ring width, EBR is confirmed; a uniform film with edge-only electrical opens instead points to bevel etch or clamp contact.

a.pattern_name: partial edge ring (left/right wafer edge clustering) on top of random defect scatter
a.process_step: Wafer edge handling/clamping at the deposition or etch chuck (check edge exclusion and clamp ring contact points); verify with edge-die-only bin analysis
a.discriminating_check: Overlay failing die radius histogram: if the excess failures are confined to the outermost 2-3 die rows at discrete azimuthal positions (matching clamp/finger locations) and repeat at the same clock positions lot-to-lot, edge clamp contact is confirmed; if the edge failures are azimuthally uniform or absent after excluding scatter, rule it out and treat as random particle contamination

b.pattern_name: none (random scatter with a small localized left-edge clump)
b.process_step: unknown
b.discriminating_check: Overlay several wafers from this lot: if the small contiguous failure block at the far left edge (same wafer-coordinate location) repeats wafer-to-wafer, it indicates a fixed hardware/edge-contact or probe-card signature; if it moves or does not repeat, the map is ordinary random defectivity and no systematic cause should be assigned.
